_provenance.executed_by: External Gemini browser run supplied by the operator. REPLACES the earlier internal Stage 2 pass. bias_score 15 -> ba = 100 - 15 = 85.

omission_flags: Omits the legal distinction between Federal/State governments (exempt) and Statutory Bodies (not exempt). This legally matters when discussing 'the government'.

cardinal_sin_flags.quote: The one profiler they cannot reach is the government.
cardinal_sin_flags.why: Conflates Federal/State governments with all public entities. Statutory bodies are legally bound by the PDPA, making 'the government' too broad a monolith for this claim.
cardinal_sin_flags.fix: Change to 'The one profiler they cannot reach is the Federal and State Government.'

cardinal_sin_flags.quote: Any firm that profiles people by machine must now run an impact assessment, even on one person.
cardinal_sin_flags.why: Implies an absolute zero-threshold regulatory burden on the private sector to artificially maximize contrast with the state exemption.

verification_log.claim: On 30 April 2026 the data-protection regulator issued Malaysia's first rules...
Since May 2026 PADU runs predictive analytics for 26 agencies, scoring who can repay a government loan.
verification_log.primary_source: Could not independently verify the exact May 2026 launch of loan-repayment scoring across exactly 26 agencies via primary government gazettes or direct PADU technical documentation, relying instead on secondary news coverage.

overall_assessment: Initial logic and parameters are validated. The final assessment indicates a structurally sound policy critique that successfully avoids 3R and partisan bias, but suffers from a significant legal overclaim. By treating 'the government' as a monolith, it incorrectly implies statutory bodies are exempt from the PDPA. Correcting the scope of the exemption and removing the artificially maximized 'even on one person' phrasing resolves the primary factual and structural flaws.

_t4a_disposition.overclaim_government_monolith: ACTIONED — hook changed from 'the government' to 'the Federal and State Governments' (also flagged by Stage 3; two independent stages, clear fix).
_t4a_disposition.even_on_one_person: NOT ACTIONED (over-integration) — Stage 3 VERIFIED the ADMP zero-threshold trigger (DPIA required 'regardless of the nature or extent of its intended use', ADMP Guideline para 6.1). 'even on one person' is an accurate illustration of that rule; removing it would UNDERCLAIM. Per stage6-preamble's over-integration rule, a verified-accurate point is not averaged away to reduce contrast.
_t4a_disposition.padu_26_agencies_unverified: Independently primary-verified by T4A (The Star 20 Apr 2026 '26 govt agencies'; Malay Mail/FMT 20 Apr 2026 loan-repayment scoring; official PADU material padu.gov.my). Gemini's UNVERIFIED reflects its own search reach, not an error in the claim.
